name: xks-memory
description: XKS-Memory: local long-term memory for Claude Code. Every turn is stored on this machine with its exact time, embedded without a neural model, and recalled into later prompts.

plugins.name: xks-memory
plugins.description: Logs every Claude Code turn (prompt, replies, tool calls, tool results, thinking) into a local XKS-Memory store with exact times, recalls related earlier turns into each prompt, and offers recall/search/remember/sessions/stats MCP tools.
